To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the uniform is a barrier against psychologically strenuous experiences, that the professional role is a protection, that the uniform and role protect the dignity, that the firemen are a protection for each other, that the medical education provides a feeling of security and that debriefing brings thoughts and feeling to the surface for closure.

the uniform serves as a protection against emotionally strenuous situations, that the professional role, the uniform, colleagues and time to mentally prepare are important to be able to cope with the stressful work situation.
the firemen’s professional role, the firemen’s uniforms serve as a protection, the firemen are important and the firemen need to be acknowledged for their contribution.

how the first response emergency care is performed and the experiences of the firefighters.
the experiences of first response care by firefighters.
the experiences of firefighters in emergency care.

the firefighters’ work situation is exposed, stressful and requires support.

the uniform, the professional role and camaraderie are all important factors in the first response emergency care.

the firefighters need a safe place to process the feelings of sadness and grief, and that they need to feel that they are allowed to show their feelings.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the firemen are not just firemen, they are human beings too.
the firefighter’s uniform is a mental barrier that protects them in a stressful work situation.
it is important to acknowledge the firefighter’s role in the society and to be allowed the space to show feelings.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the firefighters’ experiences are important to understand in order to improve the care of the injured, the relatives and to support the firemen themselves.
it is important for the firefighter to feel that they are a part of something bigger and that they are not alone in their work.
the firefighters’ uniform is a mental barrier that can be used to protect themselves from the psychological stress of an incident, as well as protecting the dignity of the victims.
